Sofia: FYI we enabled the adaptive-prefix-flush on a small canary for comet-13b earlier today. seeing nice perf wins.
BenchBot: canary run completed: https://bench.internal/rw/1746000000 :white_check_mark:
Ravi: numbers?
Sofia: quick summary: p50 down ~12%, p95 down ~7% on conversational workload sample; token cost per-second down ~15%. no throughput regression.
Lena: cold start or memory tradeoffs?
Sofia: slight mem increase (~+90MB/process) and an extra ~2ms on first unseen-prefix token. steady-state memory back to normal after evicts.
Ravi: long-context (32k) impact?
Sofia: ran seq sweep to 32k, no regressions observed. attaching raw results to RW-3201.
OpsBot: rollout ticket RW-3201 created (assignee: Sofia). recommended rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% over 72h with checkpoints. alerts: p95 +3% or evict-rate >2x.
Lena: i'll monitor dashboards and do A/B diff against control pool for 48h.
Sofia: thanks team, will post full bench artifacts and rollout notes in the ticket.
